check: GameTest suite inventory before the full re-run (goal item 2)
why: The full suite has not been run since the GameTest count changed from 119 to 129. This records what the suite contains BEFORE the run, so the 'All N required tests passed' line can be checked against a number derived independently rather than against itself.
entrypointWithoutGameTestNote: Helper used by PaletteGameTests at 7 call sites; it does not implement FabricGameTest, so listing it is harmless redundancy. The historical 119-test pass shows Fabric tolerates it.
baselineNote: The previous baseline of 119 is invalid: corridorHalfWidth changed 192 -> 512. Every fixture now passes 512 (PlanningFixtures, AdjacentComponentMatrixTests, ProductionPipelineTests, PipelineReservationHandoffAuditTests, SiteRuntimeIndexGameTests, LootInitializerTest, CanonicalCodecTest), and no 192 remains, so the re-run measures the current configuration.
subsetMechanism: -PgreatwallGameTestClasses=Name,Name filters the generated fabric.mod.json entrypoints and reports 'DIAGNOSTIC SUBSET ONLY'; an unknown name fails with 'Unknown diagnostic GameTest classes'. A subset run is therefore never a full-stage acceptance run.
